card.text: Earth-sized planet of TRAPPIST-1, one year every 2.42 days.

introduction.text: TRAPPIST-1c is 1.10 Earth radii across and 1.31 Earth masses. It circles its star every 2.42 days at 0.016 au, receiving 2.21 times the sunlight Earth does.

temperature.title: Bare rock from JWST depth
temperature.summary: A model, not a map: a bare rock as bright at 15 µm as c's measured day side. About 400 K under the star, dark at night.
